name: OECD Family Database: parental leave systems (PF2.1)

measures.definition: Paid maternity, parental and home-care leave available to mothers, in weeks at full pay (full-rate equivalent).
Paid paternity leave and parental leave reserved for fathers, in weeks at full pay (full-rate equivalent).

coverage.period: entitlements in April of the table's year

licence: OECD terms for data (any use, with citation)

rights.edition: OECD Family Database PF2.1, updated May 2026 (policies in April 2025)
rights.attribution: OECD (2026), OECD Family Database, PF2.1 Parental leave systems, https://www.oecd.org/en/data/datasets/oecd-family-database.html
notices: Reusers must cite the OECD as above and pass this acknowledgement requirement on to anyone they share the data with.

vetted.notes: The standard comparable source for paid leave.

caveats: National entitlements only: state programmes (New York or Washington paid family leave in the US) and employer schemes are not in it.

The live PF2.1 edition is updated May 2026 but measures policies in April 2025 using 2024 earnings. It is not a current-2026 statement of statutory leave; later reforms are outside these comparable full-rate-equivalent observations.
